Subject: WA seller carve-out — resale certificate available, invoice on hold

Hi Markus,

Per our conversation on the phone, Venture Distribution is registered with the State of Washington and is providing a seller-level resale certificate that covers sales to marketplace sellers under RCW marketplace facilitator rules. I've attached the WA resale cert for your review (WA-Resale-Certificate-VENTURE-2026.pdf).

We have an outstanding invoice from Redwood (INV-2026-0912, amount $47,560) that is currently on hold in our AP system. Acme Wholesale is requesting you accept the resale evidence and remove the hold so we can complete payment.

If you need a signed, notarized affidavit or a DocuSign envelope from Venture to confirm they operate as a seller for marketplace facilitation carve-outs, we can get that today — I can send the DocuSign link to speed things up.

Can you confirm what Redwood requires (signed affidavit, ship-to matching, bill-to mapping) to accept this certificate and clear the invoice? Paul (Acme) is looped here.

Thanks,
Sarah Morgan
Head of Tax & Compliance – Venture Distribution

Subject: Re: WA seller carve-out — resale certificate available, invoice on hold

Sarah — thanks for the quick follow-up and the attachment.

Short answer: we can clear the hold once we have a signed affidavit confirming Venture is the selling party for the transactions + confirmation that the WA certificate covers the ship-to addresses on INV-2026-0912. Our standard checklist is:
- Signed affidavit or notarized statement from the seller (DocuSign acceptable)
- Resale certificate that matches seller legal name and EIN (you provided that)
- Mapping of invoice line items to ship-to addresses that are covered by the certificate

Ben, please hold on payment clearance until we have the signed affidavit and the mapping. If we get a DocuSign envelope today, how quickly can AP process a release?

Lauren / Priyom — can you confirm whether a seller-level WA cert + signed affidavit is sufficient for Redwood to accept exemption for marketplace facilitator transactions, or do we require supplemental ship-to verifications? If state guidance requires anything extra, flag here.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-27T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WA seller carve-out — resale certificate available, invoice on hold

Markus — quick tax policy note: Washington allows seller-provided resale certificates to cover marketplace sales when the seller is the collecting party per RCW 82.08.026. For our acceptance: signed affidavit + certificate + ship-to match is our usual risk threshold.

If Northbridge (external tax advisor) can confirm the affidavit wording (explicitly stating marketplace facilitator carve-out and the seller legal name + EIN), that will satisfy us. We should also ensure the invoice ship-tos are listed or confirm that the certificate is a blanket certificate that explicitly covers these kinds of transactions.

Priyom — I recommend accepting the DocuSign affidavit and moving to clear the hold contingent on AP receiving the DocuSign envelope and the signed PDF. If there are multiple ship-to addresses on the invoice, request a short CSV mapping from Venture.

– Lauren
Senior Tax Counsel, Redwood Inference
